sloka: मृत्युरक्षमणीयम् माम् नयिष्यति यमक्षयम् ।राघवे हि वनम् प्राप्ते सर्वलोकस्य धिक्कृतम् ॥२-१२-८८॥
transliteration: mṛtyurakṣamaṇīyam mām nayiṣyati yamakṣayam ।rāghave hi vanam prāpte sarvalokasya dhikkṛtam ॥2-12-88॥

translations.english: If Rama goes to the forest, the god of death will conduct me to his abode, for condemned by the entire world, I shall not be forgiven (even by Yama).
